sign-in-once.title: Sign in once
sign-in-once.script: Now the AI agent needs to know who you are. It opens a sign-in for you the first time, you log in, and you come back to the terminal. You do this once, and it stays.

your-own-account.title: Your own account
your-own-account.script: Which account fits which AI agent differs, and the official page of your AI agent says it better than I could, so the link is right here. Use your own account, not a shared one, so that the AI agent is yours to run.
